data.body: **[P1] Preserve fatal failures past the invocation future.** These errors are rethrown inside the handler's `CompletableFuture`, whose generic exception branch then converts them into a normal `DurableExecutionOutput.failure`. In particular, `ThreadDeath` no longer terminates the worker and a `VirtualMachineError` is reported as an ordinary workflow failure. After unwrapping the future failure in `DurableExecutor`, finalize any published plugins and rethrow these fatal causes; add an executor-level regression test.
